title: CounterFlow: Target-Conditioned Flow Matching for Visual Counterfactuals
abstract: arXiv:2610.35679v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In eXplainable AI, counterfactual explanations have gained significant traction by offering users direct, intuitive, and actionable insights into model decisions. We introduce CounterFlow, a novel framework based on Conditional Flow Matching that generates visual counterfactual explanations by directly steering a source image toward a user-specified target class. By leveraging target-conditioned vector fields, CounterFlow identifies highly realistic semantic modifications while requiring substantially lower computational overhead than traditional GAN- or diffusion-based architectures. Empirical evaluations on standard benchmarks demonstrate that CounterFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance in both visual realism and target class switching. By working directly in the raw pixel space, CounterFlow offers a more practical solution for real-world deployment.

translated_title: CounterFlow：面向视觉反事实的目标条件流匹配
translated_abstract: 在可解释人工智能（XAI）领域，反事实解释因能为用户提供对模型决策直接、直观且可操作的洞察而获得了广泛关注。我们提出了CounterFlow，这是一个基于条件流匹配的新型框架，它通过直接将源图像引导至用户指定的目标类别来生成视觉反事实解释。通过利用目标条件向量场，CounterFlow能够识别高度逼真的语义修改，同时其计算开销显著低于传统的基于GAN或扩散模型的架构。在标准基准上的实证评估表明，CounterFlow在视觉真实感和目标类别切换两方面均达到了最先进的性能。由于直接在原始像素空间中工作，CounterFlow为实际部署提供了更实用的解决方案。
tldr: CounterFlow是一种基于条件流匹配的新型框架，通过目标条件向量场在原始像素空间中直接将图像引导至用户指定的目标类别，以远低于GAN或扩散模型的计算开销，生成视觉真实感和目标类别切换效果均达到最先进水平的视觉反事实解释。
en_tdlr: CounterFlow is a novel conditional flow matching framework that generates visual counterfactual explanations by directly steering source images toward user-specified target classes, achieving state-of-the-art visual realism and class switching with substantially lower computational overhead than GAN- or diffusion-based approaches.
